impact: A fresh Gemini review learns its conversation id by reading ~/.gemini/antigravity-cli/cache/last_conversations.json keyed by cwd after the run (readConversationId), which is why every run+capture must go through the process-global runSerialized chain — two concurrent fresh reviews would otherwise read each other's id. Since 7759fae every agy turn runs in stream-json mode, and its `init` and `result` events carry `conversation_id` directly. Returning it from runAgyPrint (e.g. Result<{ response, conversationId }>) makes the id per-process-output rather than per-shared-file: no cache scrape, no cwd-keyed lookup to get wrong, and the serialization requirement shrinks to whatever agy itself needs. Keep the cache read as a fallback only for a result event without an id. The runSerialized concurrency tests should be re-derived from the new source of truth rather than deleted.
title: Gemini: take the conversation id from the stream-json result event instead of scraping agy's cache file
